info.title: pw-dev managed proxy API
info.description: Proxy-manager-owned API. Each in-house Whistle -S profile is the durable source of truth; process lifecycle preserves it and only explicit DELETE removes it. Native deployments serve this API at /_proxy; pw-dev republishes it for agents at /_pwdev/proxy.

x-pwdev-documents.whenToUse: Create, start, stop, restart, or delete a managed proxy.
Replace a managed proxy's complete ruleset.
